key_name_too_long: This API key name is too long. Keep it within {{max_length}} characters.
key_enable_blocked: This API key has expired or used up its allowance, so it can't be enabled. Extend its expiry or raise its allowance first.
key_limit_reached: You already hold {{limit}} API keys in this project, the most allowed. Delete a key you no longer use, then create a new one.
secret_unavailable: Only a fingerprint of this API key was kept, so the full key can't be shown. Create a new key if you need the full value.
key_not_found: This API key no longer exists. It may have been deleted. Refresh the page.
usage_range_invalid: The end of the time range is earlier than its start. Adjust the range and try again.
usage_range_too_long: The time range is longer than {{max_days}} days. Choose a shorter range.
invalid_usage_summary_window: The usage summary window is invalid. Check since, until and granularity.
request_not_found: No request with this ID was found for this API key. Check the request ID.
log_session_not_found: This session was not found in the logs you can view. Refresh the page.
usage_export_format_unsupported: This export format is not supported. Export as CSV or XLSX.
log_cleanup_cutoff_too_recent: Logs from the last {{min_days}} days are kept for model rankings. Choose an earlier cutoff date.
spend_budget_not_found: This spend budget no longer exists. It may have been deleted. Refresh the page.
